t: 2-component injection mortar based on vinyl ester for fixing standard applications in cracked concrete and masonry. Expansion-free fixing for small spacings and edge distances. Allows anchorings in water-filled drill holes enabling rapid progress. Processed with the system components Fischer threaded rod FIS A and Fischer internal-threaded anchor RG M I indoors and outside. Temperature resistance of -40 to 120°C allows for a solid load level, even when subjected to high temperature demands, thus providing great flexibility.
